tasks.description: Add accessible search and status controls above the board in index.html and style them in styles.css.
acceptance_criteria: Show a labelled search field and All, To do, Doing, Done status options above the board.
Use the existing semantic page structure and responsive styling conventions.

tasks.description: Add a pure filterTasks(tasks, query, status) function in src/tasks.js without changing task data or persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Trim the query and match title or description without case sensitivity; an empty query matches all tasks.
Combine query and status filters for All, todo, doing, and done.
Return a new array without mutating the input tasks or persisting filter state.

tasks.description: Connect the controls to filterTasks in src/app.js and render visible tasks, column counts, and an empty-result message.
acceptance_criteria: Changing either control updates visible tasks; clearing both restores the full board without changing stored tasks.
Each column count reflects visible tasks, including zero; a clear empty-result message appears only when no task matches.
Existing create, edit, move, delete, and reload behavior continues to work while filters are active.

tasks.description: Add deterministic tests for filterTasks in the existing model test file.
acceptance_criteria: Cover title match, description match, case handling, trimmed and empty queries, combined status filtering, and no match.
Verify the input task array and task objects are not mutated.
npm test and both Node syntax checks pass.
